description: Format a SysML v2 / KerML document, or only the lines of a range, in the canonical style. Returns the edits and the resulting text; writes the file only with apply=true. A document that does not parse is left unchanged.

apply.description: write the formatted text to the file, replacing it atomically (its mode is kept, other inode metadata is not); false (the default) only returns the edits

path.description: the document to format, absolute or relative to the workspace root

range.description: format only the lines this range touches; omitted, the whole document

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

name: format

applied.description: whether the text was written to disk

edits.description: the edits that format the document; empty when it is already formatted

newText.description: the text that replaces the range; empty deletes it

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

text.description: the document's text with the edits applied
